Class Entity

java.lang.Object
model.common.Entity
All Implemented Interfaces:
Collidable, Damageable, Renderable, Updatable
Direct Known Subclasses:
BaseEnemy, Player
public abstract class Entity extends Object implements Updatable, Renderable, Collidable, Damageable
Abstract base class for all game entities (player, enemies). Provides common functionality for positioning, rendering, collision, and health management. Subclasses must implement specific behavior for movement and combat.

  • Constructor Details

    • Entity

      public Entity(Vec2 position, String imagePath, double width, double height, double maxHp)
      Constructs a new entity with the given properties. Loads the sprite from AssetManager and initializes HP to maximum.
      Parameters:
      position - initial position in world coordinates
      imagePath - path to sprite image in resources
      width - entity width in pixels
      height - entity height in pixels
      maxHp - maximum and initial health points

      public void update(double dt)
      Updates this entity's position based on current velocity. Subclasses should call super.update(dt) and add their own update logic.
      Specified by:

      Parameters:
      dt - time elapsed since last update in seconds
